definitionZh: 当您与画布对象交互时，您正在处理不以像素为单位测量的空间坐标。在这种情况下，您可以使用变换函数将屏幕值映射到空间。
sourceDefinition: When you're interacting with canvas objects, you're dealing with space coordinates that aren't measured in pixels. In that case, you can tell to map screen values to the space with a transform function.
